activity.notes: On 16 July 1961 Kalonji assumed the Luba sovereign title Mulopwe and South Kasai was styled the Federated Kingdom of South Kasai. His rule ended in 1962 as the secessionist/autonomous regime collapsed. This is modeled separately from his earlier presidential headship because both the polity styling and sovereign title changed.

sources.title: South Kasai
sources.citation_text: The compiled history records Kalonji's accession as Mulopwe on 16 July 1961 and the corresponding change of the state's title to the Federated Kingdom of South Kasai.

sources.title: Albert Kalonji
sources.citation_text: The biographical chronology records Kalonji as head of state of South Kasai until 5 October 1962, first as president and later as king/Mulopwe.
